Each analysis below is a reproducible document: the methods, the code that ran
them, and the output in one place. They differ in what the outcome data allow.

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.analysis-card}
### [HTE analysis pipeline](hte-pipeline.qmd)

For outcomes observed on every randomized patient. Conditional average treatment
effects estimated with BART, subgroups discovered by fitting a tree to those
estimates, sensitivity to the prior and to other estimators, heterogeneity by
prognostic score, and randomization-based bounds on the distribution of
individual effects.
:::

::: {.analysis-card}
### [Heterogeneous survivor average causal effects](sace-csace.qmd)

For outcomes truncated by a terminal event, where the outcome is undefined or
unobserved for participants who die. Principal stratification defines the effect
among always-survivors, and BART estimates both the average and heterogeneous
effects on that stratum.
:::

:::

The [tutorial](../tutorial.qmd) walks through running the HTE analysis pipeline
on a new trial, for a binary or continuous outcome observed on all patients.

If you would like help applying any of this to a trial of your own, please
[get in touch](../people.qmd).
